identity.note: Mk8 hatch. Year/trim NOT verifiable from references — never guessed (accuracy rule). This file is DATA: published figures with sources; the machine's stage code contains no car-specific numbers.

length_m.source: published VW Golf Mk8 hatch dimensions

width_m.source: published VW Golf Mk8 hatch dimensions (excl. mirrors)

height_m.source: published VW Golf Mk8 hatch dimensions

wheelbase_m.source: published VW Golf Mk8 hatch dimensions

front_overhang_m.source: published Mk8 proportions (L 4.284 - WB 2.619 = 1.665 total; front/rear split per published side profile)

glass_thickness_m.source: typical laminated automotive glazing 3-5mm; pinned so the stage's length-scaled default never drifts this car

tyre.source: published standard Mk8 Golf fitment; matches this body's measured arch radius (old tyres ~0.317m). Trim unverified -> wheel DESIGN is provisional neutral 10-spoke.

expect.note: detector self-test values: the SOURCE body's arch positions as measured pre-alignment (Arch_Cavity quadrant clusters, 2026-08-18). Their span (2.503) deliberately differs from wheelbase_m (2.619) because the source body's arches ARE wrong — that is what body_align corrects. Post-alignment runs self-test against the DERIVED spec body_align emits, not this block.

glass.note: V41-frame values (glass stage runs on the baseline, pre-alignment): B-pillar centre measured 2026-08-18 from the densest carpaint column in the DLO band; 6 panes = windscreen, 4 sides, rear screen.
